title: Little Erhei Gets Married
synopsis: The story of Little Erhei’s marriage, adapted from Zhao Shuli’s famous short story.

fullText.simplified:
多喜结婚

    因为开会的事，小二黑想和多喜结婚了。小二黑知道他和多喜是可以结婚的，这不是错事，所以开始和多喜商量结婚的事情。
    三花知道这件事后，没有高兴，却很着急。多喜虽然是她的女儿，但是这几年来，她却不太喜欢这个女儿。因为三花爱的是那些小伙子们，但那些小伙子们却爱的是多喜。小二黑这个孩子，在三花看来，就是一个鲜果，但是多了一个多喜，就没自己什么事了。她想早点给多喜找一个丈夫，让多喜结婚，这样她就可以和小二黑玩了。但是，大家都和高老汉一样，觉得三花那么爱和男人玩，她的女儿也一样。所以，没有人愿意让自己的儿子和多喜结婚。
    现在大家都说小二黑和多喜要结婚了。三花想：要是真是那样的话，以后跟小二黑连笑话都不能说了，那多难过啊。所以，三花急了，见人就说：“让你的儿子和我的女儿多喜结婚吧！”
    有个张先生，是别的村的，家里很有钱，刚刚没了妻子。多喜去别的村买菜的时候，他见过多喜一次。听说三花在给多喜找丈夫，就去找三花，说他愿意和多喜结婚。三花二话不说就同意了。几天后，她收了张先生的见面礼，这件事就算定了。
    谁知，多喜已经决定和小二黑结婚了，她怎么可能听她妈妈的话？她看到三花收了那么多张先生的见面礼，就让她把东西都送回去，但是三花不干。
    多喜很生气，她把张先生送来的见面礼全部都放在三花手上，说：“我不管！谁收了张先生的钱，谁就和他结婚去！”说完，就跑进了自己的房间。
    三花看到女儿不听她的话，就想了一个办法。晚饭过后，三花又拿出她的那朵大红花，戴在头上，说是天神住进了她的身子里，现在说话的是天神。
    “天神”先看向多喜的爸爸水生，大声说道：“水生，你怎么回事？连自己的女儿都管不好！”
    水生看到是天神在说话，忙站了起来。
    “天神”又看向多喜，很生气地说：“多喜！是我让你和张先生结婚的！你连天神的话都不听了吗？”
    多喜坐在那儿，不说话。水生看到“天神”生气了，很害怕。他跑过去，拉着女儿站起来，笑着对“天神”说：“天神，小孩子不懂事，您别生气！”
    “天神”看到多喜不说话，更生气了。她对水生说：“你家孩子太不懂事了！你帮我打她！让她认错！”
    多喜听了这话，知道跟这个总是扮成天神的妈妈说什么也没用，就跑出门了。她一个人跑到村东边找小二黑，两个人拉着手走进地里商量解决的办法。
fullText.traditional:
多喜結婚

    因為開會的事，小二黑想和多喜結婚了。小二黑知道他和多喜是可以結婚的，這不是錯事，所以開始和多喜商量結婚的事情。
    三花知道這件事後，沒有高興，卻很著急。多喜雖然是她的女兒，但是這幾年來，她卻不太喜歡這個女兒。因為三花愛的是那些小伙子們，但那些小伙子們卻愛的是多喜。小二黑這個孩子，在三花看來，就是一個鮮果，但是多了一個多喜，就沒自己什麼事了。她想早點給多喜找一個丈夫，讓多喜結婚，這樣她就可以和小二黑玩了。但是，大家都和高老漢一樣，覺得三花那麼愛和男人玩，她的女兒也一樣。所以，沒有人願意讓自己的兒子和多喜結婚。
    現在大家都說小二黑和多喜要結婚了。三花想：要是真是那樣的話，以後跟小二黑連笑話都不能說了，那多難過啊。所以，三花急了，見人就說：“讓你的兒子和我的女兒多喜結婚吧！”
    有個張先生，是別的村的，家裡很有錢，剛剛沒了妻子。多喜去別的村買菜的時候，他見過多喜一次。聽說三花在給多喜找丈夫，就去找三花，說他願意和多喜結婚。三花二話不說就同意了。幾天後，她收了張先生的見面禮，這件事就算定了。
    誰知，多喜已經決定和小二黑結婚了，她怎麼可能聽她媽媽的話？她看到三花收了那麼多張先生的見面禮，就讓她把東西都送回去，但是三花不幹。
    多喜很生氣，她把張先生送來的見面禮全部都放在三花手上，說：“我不管！誰收了張先生的錢，誰就和他結婚去！”說完，就跑進了自己的房間。
    三花看到女兒不聽她的話，就想了一個辦法。晚飯過後，三花又拿出她的那朵大紅花，戴在頭上，說是天神住進了她的身子裡，現在說話的是天神。
    “天神”先看向多喜的爸爸水生，大聲說道：“水生，你怎麼回事？連自己的女兒都管不好！”
    水生看到是天神在說話，忙站了起來。
    “天神”又看向多喜，很生氣地說：“多喜！是我讓你和張先生結婚的！你連天神的話都不聽了嗎？”
    多喜坐在那兒，不說話。水生看到“天神”生氣了，很害怕。他跑過去，拉著女兒站起來，笑著對“天神”說：“天神，小孩子不懂事，您別生氣！”
    “天神”看到多喜不說話，更生氣了。她對水生說：“你家孩子太不懂事了！你幫我打她！讓她認錯！”
    多喜聽了這話，知道跟這個總是扮成天神的媽媽說什麼也沒用，就跑出門了。她一個人跑到村東邊找小二黑，兩個人拉著手走進地裡商量解決的辦法。

sentences.simplified: 多喜坐在那儿，不说话。水生看到“天神”生气了，很害怕。
sentences.traditional: 多喜坐在那兒，不說話。水生看到“天神”生氣了，很害怕。
sentences.pinyin: duō xǐ zuò zài nà'r bù shuō huà shuǐ shēng kàn dào tiān shén shēng qì le hěn hài pà
sentences.english: Duoxi sat in place and did not say anything. Shuisheng saw that the “god” was angry, and was very afraid.

sentences.simplified: 他跑过去，拉着女儿站起来，
sentences.traditional: 他跑過去，拉著女兒站起來，
sentences.pinyin: tā pǎo guò qu lā zhe nǚ ér zhàn qǐ lái
sentences.english: He ran over and pulled his daughter up.

sentences.simplified: 笑着对“天神”说：“天神，小孩子不懂事，您别生气！”
sentences.traditional: 笑著對“天神”說：“天神，小孩子不懂事，您別生氣！”
sentences.pinyin: xiào zhe duì tiān shén shuō tiān shén xiǎo hái zi bù dǒng shì nín bié shēng qì
sentences.english: Smiling, he said to the “god”, “God, the child doesn’t know better. Don’t be angry!”

sentences.simplified: “天神”看到多喜不说话，更生气了。
sentences.traditional: “天神”看到多喜不說話，更生氣了。
sentences.pinyin: tiān shén kàn dào duō xǐ bù shuō huà gèng shēng qì le
sentences.english: The “god” saw that Duoxi didn’t say anything and became even angrier.

sentences.simplified: 她对水生说：“你家孩子太不懂事了！你帮我打她！让她认错！”
sentences.traditional: 她對水生說：“你家孩子太不懂事了！你幫我打她！讓她認錯！”
sentences.pinyin: tā duì shuǐ shēng shuō nǐ jiā hái zi tài bù dǒng shì le nǐ bāng wǒ dǎ tā ràng tā rèn cuò
sentences.english: She said to Shuisheng, “Your child really doesn’t know better! Beat her for me! Make her admit her mistake!”

sentences.simplified: 多喜听了这话，知道跟这个总是扮成天神的妈妈说什么也没用，就跑出门了。
sentences.traditional: 多喜聽了這話，知道跟這個總是扮成天神的媽媽說什麼也沒用，就跑出門了。
sentences.pinyin: duō xǐ tīng le zhè huà zhī dào gēn zhè ge zǒng shì bàn chéng tiān shén de mā ma shuō shén me yě méi yòng jiù pǎo chū mén le
sentences.english: Duoxi heard this, and knowing that it was futile to say anything to her mom who always dressed up as a god, ran out of the house.

sentences.simplified: 她一个人跑到村东边找小二黑，
sentences.traditional: 她一個人跑到村東邊找小二黑，
sentences.pinyin: tā yí ge rén pǎo dào cūn dōng bian zhǎo xiǎo èr hēi
sentences.english: She ran to the east side of the village to look for Little Erhei, ..

sentences.simplified: 两个人拉着手走进地里商量解决的办法。
sentences.traditional: 兩個人拉著手走進地裡商量解決的辦法。
sentences.pinyin: liǎng ge rén lā zhe shǒu zǒu jìn dì lǐ shāng liang jiě jué de bàn fǎ
sentences.english: .. and the two of them walked into the fields holding hands to discuss a solution.

raw.synopsis: The story of Little Erhei’s marriage, adapted from Zhao Shuli’s famous short story.
sentence_translations: Duoxi Gets Married
Because of what happened at the meeting, Little Erhei wanted to get married to Duoxi.
Little Erhei knew that he and Duoxi could get married. It was not something wrong.
So, he started discussing marriage with Duoxi.
After Sanhua knew of this, she was not happy. In fact, she was very anxious.
Although Duoxi was her daughter, in the last few years, she hadn’t been too fond of this daughter.
Because what Sanhua loved were those young guys, but what those young guys loved was Duoxi.
In the eyes of Sanhua, this child Little Erhei was a fresh fruit.
But with Duoxi in the equation, there was nothing left for her.
She wanted to quickly find a husband for Duoxi, so Duoxi would be married.
This way, she would be able to have fun with Little Erhei.
But, everyone thought the same as Gao Laohan, because Sanhua loved having fun with men, her daughter must also be the same.
Therefore, nobody was willing to let their son get married to Duoxi.
Now, everybody was saying that Little Erhei will get married to Duoxi.
Sanhua thought: If it really must be so, then in the future, I can’t even joke with Little Erhei. How sad would that be!
Hence, Sanhua became anxious.
Whenever she saw anyone she would say, “How about your son and my daughter Duoxi get married!”
There was a person called Mr. Zhang from another village.
His family was very wealthy and he had recently lost his wife.
He had seen Duoxi once before when she went to the other village to buy groceries.
Hearing that Sanhua was looking for a husband for Duoxi, he went to see Sanhua and said he was willing to marry Duoxi.
Sanhua immediately agreed. A few days later, she received Mr. Zhang’s greeting gifts, and the matter was settled.
Who would have thought that Duoxi had already decided to get married to Little Erhei.
How could she possibly listen to her mother?
She saw that Sanhua had received many greeting gifts from Mr. Zhang, and asked her to return them. But Sanhua refused.
Duoxi was very angry. She handed all of Mr. Zhang’s greeting gifts to Sanhua, saying, ..
.. “I don’t care! Whoever accepts Mr. Zhang’s money should be the one to marry him!”
After saying this, she ran into her own room.
Sanhua saw that her daughter wouldn’t listen to her and thought of an idea.
After dinner, Sanhua took out her big red flower and wore it on her head.
She said that a god had entered her body and that the god was now speaking.
The “god” first looked towards Duoxi’s father Shuisheng, and said in a loud voice, ..
.. “Shuisheng, what’s going on? You can’t even control your own daughter!”
Shuisheng saw that it was a god who was speaking, and hurriedly stood up.
The “god” then looked towards Duoxi, and said angrily, ..
.. “Duoxi! It is me who arranged for you and Mr. Zhang to get married! You won’t even listen to the words of a god?”
Duoxi sat in place and did not say anything. Shuisheng saw that the “god” was angry, and was very afraid.
He ran over and pulled his daughter up.
Smiling, he said to the “god”, “God, the child doesn’t know better. Don’t be angry!”
The “god” saw that Duoxi didn’t say anything and became even angrier.
She said to Shuisheng, “Your child really doesn’t know better! Beat her for me! Make her admit her mistake!”
Duoxi heard this, and knowing that it was futile to say anything to her mom who always dressed up as a god, ran out of the house.
She ran to the east side of the village to look for Little Erhei, ..
.. and the two of them walked into the fields holding hands to discuss a solution.
